extracted.name: Heathy Muffins
extracted.description: Our easy Healthy Muffins recipe actually tastes good, made with wholesome ingredients like Greek yogurt, oats, and honey for a naturally sweet, moist muffin while still having the best texture.
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil* ((80ml), light or mild flavor)
2 cups blueberries (, (or 1 cup chocolate chips, craisins or other mix-ins))
instruction_lines: Mix Wet Ingredients: Combine milk, olive oil, Greek yogurt, honey, egg and orange zest in a mixing bowl.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a separate mixing bowl, combine flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon. Pour dry ingredients into wet ingredients and mix only until combined.
Grease a 12-cup standard muffin tin. Divide batter among muffin cups (they will be full!).
Bake at 350 degrees F (180 degrees C) for 13-18 minutes, or until cooked through and a toothpick inserted comes out clean
